reviews.text: We love this place. Michael takes such good care of our baby Remi (and she is not an easy dog). We have been coming here for about 8 months. The service is better than any other salon I’ve been to in Houston.

Our dog Oliver is a rescue we have had almost a year.  His prior home left him so reactive to grooming and vet examinations, he had to be sedated for both.  Our goal was to move out of sedated grooming and into a normal type grooming situation due to Oliver’s health.   We worked with Ashley and she groomed Oliver completely, we were thrilled, astounded and overjoyed to say the least.   During the groom, she would come out and check with us, give a status report etc, very professional and thoughtful!   She performed the impossible, and he looks and feels great!   Thank you Ashley and Pet Barber-

What a great experience! We were having trouble finding a groomer that is comfortable with geriatric dogs and The Pet Barber just said: sure! Paul was amazing and gentle. Great availability, grooming time, and value. Our old fella came home happy, unhurt, and looking amazing. Would highly recommend.
Ashley always gets my puppy right!

We are so happy with our experience at The Pet Barber (Wirt). Ashley does a beautiful job of grooming our Pomeranian. The products she uses make our dog's coat so healthy and silky. Everyone is so friendly to both people and dogs. They take extra care for the senior dogs, too.
Happy with my dog here. Been a handful of times for grooming and always pleased! Pricing is fair.

Took both my miniature schnauzers. They said first come first served. One was do by 2:00 the other not til 4:30. They are the worst cuts they have ever had. The hair is not even on their faces one was shaved to the skin between her eyes. Will never take my girls back to these yahoos!
Nice people.  They have been taking care of all our family dogs.  We drive from Sugar Land to take one of our dogs there.  They are true professionals and caring.
Diamond was amazing with my dog! We love coming here.
Have been using them for years for my doodles!
My bernadoodle comes here weekly. Maria does amazing with his full groom always. Love all the staff here. They’re all sweet and friendly. Clean facility as well.
Great service and grooming.  Always friendly, trustworthy, and professional.
This is my new go-to pet barber for my pup. Service is always great!! Savanah does an amazing job and my pup LOVES her!! Thank you everyone for always being so great :)

The Pet Barber is our “go-to” location for Dakota for grooming and playtime. She always loves coming and has so much fun and returns so adorable. When the groomer I loved had to leave to care for his Mother, I was nervous about having a new groomer bc Dakota has had some BAD haircuts in her day from previous other grooming locations. But, I have found each groomer at the pet barber is excellent and we LOVE Maria!
My 10 year old schnoodle, Eloise, has been coming here for years! We’ve never experienced anything other than amazing service and the cutest teddybear haircuts!
Our dog had been getting groomed here for years!  They are friendly and do a great job!

This was my first time coming here, even though I’ve known about this place for a while I finally decided to give it a try. My girl was looking a little crusty, and it was definitely time for a fresh new look. The staff was super friendly and welcoming when I dropped her off, which made me feel good right away. I went back to work and returned later to pick her up and let me tell you, she walked out of those doors like a brand-new woman! I was honestly shocked (in the best way) by the transformation. She looked absolutely beautiful, and I couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out.
A big thank you to Ashley at the Wirt Rd location for making our little Maxine so glamorous. We’ll see you again soon.
Awesome job every time!
Always love taking my dog here! Everyone always treats her as their own. Nami loves her grooming appointments with Maria and Diamond.

It was really difficult to find a groomer that i could trust with my pups! But I’m glad I found the pet barber. My pups are not only safe here but the service always turns out well and they get play time outside of the kennel!

I bring my maltipoo here & I love that I get to talk to the groomer every time to go over what I want done. I also love that he gets to play in daycare while waiting instead of sitting in a cage all day! All staff is super nice as well.

My Lab Chappie has been coming to The Pet Barber since she was a puppy!!!  She loves EVERYONE and EVERYONE loves her!!!  She comes to doggy day care at least once a week and she has made alot of new 4 legged friends.  Such a treat for her and she comes home exhausted!

We only have her groomed several times a year but when we do, she is so happy -and pretty!

I give The Pet Barber five stars all around!!!

The Pet Barber is wonderful.  They are efficient, reliable, and considerate.  Savannah, our groomer, is conscientious and great with the details in caring for and grooming our cavapoo.  When I did not book well in advance, I had to try other services in town and these folks provide the best care of all!  Now I am certain to always book in advance so I do not need to go elsewhere ever again!  Their prices are fair and they run their business extremely well.

I have 3 dogs that all see Savannah regularly. She does an excellent job every single time!  Jasmine is usually at the front desk and is always so friendly and welcoming.  I love knowing my fur babies are so well cared for while they are there.  🐶💞. Highly recommend!!
I’ve been taking my Mini Schnauzer to Savannah for over a year. She does an amazing job and he always looks great after. Lots of compliments and he hasn’t had a bad experience yet.

I drive all the way from south Houston to the Pet Barber because they are WORTH it! I won't bring my full sized bernedoodle anywhere else. Facility is super clean, groomers are kind, professional, and they always do an excellent job. Special shout outs to Miss Savannah - you're the best!

We took our Airedale terrier here to get a traditional cut for her breed. I was so disappointed when I picked her up. They gave her a summer cut and it is terrible. I was assured the groomers knew how to clip her hair to give her a show dog look. Do not take your dog here if you want your dog to have a breed specific cut. They don’t know what they’re doing.
<< ASK for Maria >> she is the expert in Doodles.

I had been taking my dog to the Pet Barber for about two years. On Saturday, I dropped him off at 9am and didn’t hear anything until 3pm. When I picked him up, I learned he had been cut on his paw and had bled significantly. The groomer recommended I take him to the vet. Over the next few days, my dog needed two vet visits, stitches under anesthesia, and over $500 in medical care. He now has to wear a cone for two weeks. The groomers offered little apology, and the Pet Barber still charged me full price, including the tip. I won’t be returning. They've also raised their prices significantly — and they're just not worth it.

I have been using Pet Barber for my goldendoodle for about a year now. They are very attentive to your instructions on the grooming. It may take a few times to find the right cut you like on your pooch or the right groomer that they like but once you do, it's very easy to repeat.

My baby, Caesar, has been going to this place for the last several years. He gets a fabulous grooming (from anyone on the tram there). He loves going to daycare too! The owner, manager and staff treat my baby like it was their own. Highly recommend!

My dearest child, Teddy, our 9 lb toy poodle has been a frequent customer at The Pet Barber for several years now. Although I cannot say he’s a fan of getting his hair maintenance, his parents certainly are. Despite the long trek, we drive down from the woodlands area each time. His groomer does a fantastic job and he is the sweetest little floofy bear for the duration of his blowout.

For superior pet grooming services, The Pet Barber provides exceptional care and an unparalleled experience.  Their friendly staff possesses extensive knowledge and delivers brilliant results, ensuring your pet receives optimal treatment.  The comfortable waiting area welcomes you and your pet, accommodating all breeds.  I highly recommend The Pet Barber for your pet's next grooming appointment.
Great groomers.
The Pet Barber is a great place for grooming. I’ve always had good experiences when I take my dog.  The attention and care from the staff is A+
Best groomer in Houston by far!
Seems they’ve had some turnover, but the employees remain courteous. They cut my dog a bit shorter than I would like, but he still looked handsome and I didn’t mind it

I really don’t like or appreciate the quality of the haircut they gave to my dog. I was skeptical to try this place and now I full on regret it and cried in the car on the way home because they completely changed the way my dog looked. I asked them to shape her chest and butt and take her hair shorter but to the point where they preserved her red. She has white spots showing everywhere that were before covered with her red hair. I asked them to please not shave her and I confirmed with them when I picked her up and they said they didn’t but it’s hard to tell. If they did shave her hair will not grow back. Not to mention the haircut is extremely uneven and choppy. I’m distraught after this groom and will not be taking my dog back. See for the before and after.

I took my Pomski, Checo, to The Pet Barber in April, hoping for a simple trim, but my experience was a nightmare. I dropped him off with Carly around 9 a.m. and didn't pick him up until they were about to close. I had to keep calling for updates, as they gave no time estimate and didn't reach out all day. When I finally got Checo back, he was completely shaved down.

At first, I just thought they cut his hair way too short, but after a couple of months, our vet informed us that the shaving had permanently damaged his double coat, leading to alopecia. When I called the groomer to explain the situation, I was given the run-around, transferred to random staff members when asked for management and eventually got a call back from a manager who dismissively asked, "Why are you just now complaining?" The response was shockingly unprofessional, and they downplayed everything.

When I finally spoke with the owner, he was unbelievably arrogant. Instead of apologizing or offering a refund, he said that "this will happen at any groomer" and bragged about his business success and how they are top rated and how he makes so much money for investors. He didn't care about the permanent damage done to my dog's coat; he just offered a couple of bi-weekly baths, which felt like a slap in the face. He even admitted that Carly was just hired from the Woodlands to help with overflow and hadn't been properly vetted.

The Pet Barber's negligence and complete lack of accountability caused irreversible damage to my dog's coat. I wouldn't recommend this place to my worst enemy. If you care about your pet's well-being, stay far away from The Pet Barber.
The Best !!!
They do a great job with nail trims.
Quality
